# Namespace Lab

> Namespace Lab is a software company. We build custom software, CRMs, web apps, iOS and Android apps, Salesforce solutions (admin support, Apex and LWC development, Flow automation) and AI-powered apps and automation.

## Key facts
- Process: discovery, planning, design, development in sprints, testing, deployment and support.
- Stack: React, Next.js, Node.js/Express, Python (Django, FastAPI), PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, Azure, Vercel, Docker and GitHub Actions, React Native, Flutter; AI with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, open-source LLMs, LangChain and vector databases.
- Salesforce scope: admin support, custom development (Apex, Lightning Web Components), workflow automation (Flow), and NPSP, Nonprofit Cloud and Education Cloud configuration. No Revenue Cloud, CPQ or RevOps.
- Dedicated developers and team extension are available.
- No client case studies are published yet. Lab designs are concept designs with sample data, not client work.
